title_hi: चिंटू और मिठू का जादुई वर्णमाला परेड
title_en: Chintu and Mithu Animal Alphabet Parade
description: Chintu the elephant and Mithu the parrot explore the magical animal alphabet parade! Join the fun for toddlers to learn letters through dance.
learning: Learning the alphabet through identifying animals in a magical parade setting.

scenes.text: Arrey! Magic box mein kya chhupa hai?
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up of a vibrant, floating, sparkling magical box in a 3D jungle setting. Chintu the orange baby elephant with a blue scarf is looking at it with wide, curious eyes. Bright, cheerful lighting, 9:16 vertical orientation.

scenes.text: Tap tap tap, open the lid!
scenes.image_prompt: Mithu the green parrot with a red cap is flying over the box, tapping it with his tiny beak. Vibrant tropical flowers in the background, 3D CGI style.
A cute cartoon alligator wearing a party hat pops out of the magic box. Chintu is dancing joyfully next to it, 3D render, high contrast colors.

scenes.text: Boing boing hop, B for Bear!
scenes.image_prompt: A fluffy teddy bear jumps out of the box and bounces on a cloud. Mithu is cheering and flapping wings, bright sunny environment.

scenes.text: Wow! C for Cat, dance with us!
scenes.image_prompt: A cute kitten wearing a bow tie performs a silly dance move. Chintu is swaying his trunk to the music, toddler-friendly animation.

scenes.text: One, two, three, dance with glee!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu, Mithu, the alligator, bear, and kitten are all forming a parade line, walking in a happy circle. Playful atmosphere, soft depth of field.
All characters laughing and jumping in a group hug. Confetti is falling from the sky, vibrant 3D animation style, big happy faces.

scenes.text: Ruko! Magic box mein phir se dekho...
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu and Mithu pointing back at the closed, glowing magic box, inviting the viewer to watch again. The scene is perfectly set to loop back to the start.
